stages.name: Deploy
stages.interface: a running agent with an identity, an address and an inbox; its Descriptor signed and registered; settings, credentials (placed by name) and ceilings in place before it starts; a signed deployment record

stages.name: Publish
stages.interface: an address a person can open, and the digest of what's there

stages.name: Retract
stages.interface: a record of what was taken down, by whom, and when

stages.name: Monitor
stages.interface: whether each agent is alive, answering, and inside its limits

stages.name: Eval
stages.interface: a graded judgment, with a reason on each grade

stages.name: Incident response
stages.interface: a timeline of what's known, with every gap marked

stages.name: Cost
stages.interface: what was spent, by whom, against what was allowed

stages.name: Update
stages.interface: the same agent on the new version, with what changed recorded

stages.name: Reconfigure
stages.interface: the same agent on the same version, and a signed record of what changed

stages.name: Rollback
stages.interface: the agent back on that version, why, and what can't be undone

stages.name: Decommission
stages.interface: nothing running, the records kept, and the address retired
